note: Re-judged 2026-11-27 independently against RFC 5216 Section 2.1.3 (rfc/full/rfc5216.txt). TestRFC5216SuccessfulTerminationSendsFlightAckThenSuccess and TestRFC5216NoClosingFlightOrSuccessWhenThePeerIsRejected only added ServerIdentity="eap-tls-server". Positive still asserts the EAP-TLS Request directly before EAP-Success carries [change_cipher_spec, handshake] records and yields matching non-zero MSKs; negative still asserts no change_cipher_spec record and no EAP-Success when the peer certificate is rejected. Verdict stands: enforced.
